title: Opus-backed planner replaces the line-split heuristic
task_body: The Layer-4 planner used a naive newline-split heuristic to turn a mission into tasks. Replace it with an Opus-backed solver that produces a structured plan via a JSON schema. Keep the heuristic as a fallback when the LLM is unavailable.
rationale: opus.rs owns the new path; heuristic stays as fallback; schema describes the LLM output; planner.rs orchestrates; lib re-exports; tests pin behavior.
